cands.title: File:The Boxer At Rest Rome.jpg
cands.desc: The Boxer at Rest (or Terme Boxer) is a bronze Hellenistic Greek sculpture found in Rome in 1885. The date of creation has been debated but falls between 330 to 350 BCE. The statue is now housed at the National Museum of Rome.
